<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">To the extent required by Item 3.03 of Form 8-K, the information regarding the Reverse Stock Split contained in Item 5.03 of this Current Report on Form 8-K is incorporated by reference herein.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Item 5.03 Amendments to Articles of Incorporation or Name Change and Reverse Stock Split.</span></p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Reverse Stock Split</span></p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On May 4, 2026, the Board of Directors and shareholders owning a majority of the Company&#8217;s issued and outstanding common stock approved an amendment to the Company&#8217;s Articles of Incorporation (the &#8220;Articles&#8221;) to change the Company&#8217;s name and to implement a reverse stock split of the Company&#8217;s common stock, par value $0.001 per share, at a fixed ratio of 1-for-10.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On June 29, 2026, the Company received confirmation of acceptance of its filing of a certificate of amendment to the Articles (the &#8220;Certificate of Amendment&#8221;) with the Secretary of State of the State of Nevada, to implement a 1-for-10 reverse split of the Company&#8217;s common stock (the &#8220;Reverse Stock Split&#8221;). The Reverse Stock Split became effective as of July 2, 2026, and the Company&#8217;s common stock began trading on the OTC Markets on a post-split basis at the open of trading on July 3, 2026, with a new CUSIP number. The trading symbol for the Company&#8217;s common stock will be &#8220;UBYH&#8221; for a period of 20 days.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The new CUSIP number for the Common Stock following the Reverse Stock Split is 90347T109. Upon effectiveness of the Reverse Stock Split, every ten (10) shares of the Company&#8217;s issued, and outstanding Common Stock were reclassified and combined into one (1) share of Common Stock. Accordingly, the number of issued and outstanding shares of Common Stock of the Company was reduced from 5,687,356,400 shares before the Reverse Stock Split to 568,735,640 shares after the Reverse Stock Split. No fractional shares were issued; instead, any fractional entitlement was rounded up to the next highest whole number at the participant level. The Reverse Stock Split did not alter the par value of the Company&#8217;s common stock or modify any voting rights or other terms of the common stock.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The shares will remain in certificate form. All existing certificates will still be valid; however, the books and records of the transfer agent will reflect the post-share amount for each certificate</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Name Change</span></p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On May 4, 2026, the Board of Directors and shareholders owning a majority of the Company&#8217;s issued and outstanding common stock approved an amendment to the Company&#8217;s Articles of Incorporation (the &#8220;Certificate of Amendment&#8221;) to change the name of the Company from &#8220;UbuyHoldings, Inc.&#8221; to &#8220;Longevity Diversified Holdings, Inc.&#8221; effective on July 2.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">For a reverse or forward split, a &#8220;D&#8221; will be placed on our UBHY ticker symbol for 20 business days. <span style="text-decoration: underline">At the conclusion of 20 business days, the ticker symbol will be changed to <b>LGVT</b>, subject to confirmation that the symbol remains available</span></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Existing stock certificates representing shares of the Company&#8217;s common stock will not be affected by the Name Change and will not need to be exchanged. Any new stock certificates issued will bear the name &#8220;Longevity Diversified Holdings, Inc.&#8221;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The above description of the Certificate of Amendment, the Name Change and the Reverse Stock Split is a summary of the material terms thereof and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the Certificate of Amendment, a copy of which is attached hereto as Exhibit 3.1, as filed with the Secretary of State of the State of Nevada on June 29, 2026.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Item
5.07 Submission of Matters to a Vote of Security Holders.</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">To
the extent required by Item 5.07 of Form 8-K, the information regarding the Name Change and the Reverse Stock Split contained in
Item 5.03 of this Current Report on Form 8-K is incorporated by reference herein.</span></p>

9.01 Financial Statements and Exhibits.</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(d) Exhibits</span></p>
